run_download_bmvs: run the BlendedMVS dataset download script with --target_dir to download, combine, and extract all datasets
run_download_bmvs_parallel: run the download script with --max_workers to control parallel download and unzip workers
summarize_get_all_urls_to_download: summarize the get_all_urls_to_download function that generates all BlendedMVS dataset URLs from config
review_download_file: review the download_file function that streams a URL to disk with a tqdm progress bar
refactor_combine_split_zip: refactor the combine_split_zip function that merges split zip archives using the zip CLI utility
